title: Baggage Fee Waiver Text
scenario: At the airport, a text offers to waive your baggage fee if you confirm an upgrade.

answers.A: Check the fee and upgrade inside your airline booking.
answers.B: Pay or enter card details through the text link.
answers.C: Reply to the text and ask which flight it refers to.
answers.D: Ask the staffed airline desk using the number on your boarding pass.

explanation: Airport pressure makes a fake fee look plausible. Confirm the charge in your booking or with staff before paying.
proTip: Urgency at the airport is exactly when to use a known channel.
